{{#invoke:ShipModules|infobox}}<noinclude>
== Usage ==
Infobox for ship module articles.

The template is wired to structured stub data in [[Module:Data/ShipModules/index|Module:Data/ShipModules/index]].
Article-level parameters can override structured defaults later, once facts are
ready to be filled.

Normal article usage should be the same data-backed pattern used by Engineer pages:

<pre>{{Ship module infobox}}</pre>

The template automatically uses the current page title and structured defaults from
<code>Module:Data/ShipModules/&lt;Page name&gt;</code>. Article-level parameters remain
available as an escape hatch, but should not be left as empty manual boilerplate on
module articles.
